content: creack/pty v1.1.24 (May 2025, MIT): pty.Start deprecated in favor of StartWithAttrs/StartWithSize; Start returns nil pipe (naive close panics). Biggest pitfall: closing the pty master does NOT reliably kill children — background processes survive SIGHUP; mitigations are Setsid+Setctty SysProcAttr, exec.CommandContext, explicit process-group kill (syscall.Kill(-pgid)), and always cmd.Wait to avoid zombies.
